description: Define invisible story scaffolding for The Main Thread hands-on tutorials: why the problem matters, what gets built, what readers need, how the code works, how it fails, how to configure it, how to prove it, and how to close the loop. Use when planning, drafting, rewriting, or reviewing a full tutorial, quick guide, architecture article, or code-heavy explanation that needs production framing, complete code, verification commands, and a contained narrative. Use O'Reilly mechanics for cleanup only, not as the prose voice. Pair with authentic-voice for personal technical narration and article-reviewer for structured critique. Verify version-sensitive facts with current docs or tools rather than memory.
